correctness.rationale: The local rule exactly factors through 49 ordered nonempty color-support mask pairs. The explicit finite transition table has five nonzero recurrent support components and the all-zero singleton; every nonzero recurrent component induces uniform +1 color rotation with primitive period three. Every other mask enters within four steps. Surjection weighting yields the nine displayed first-entry cells, and their algebraic sums give the basin and orbit formulas; direct graph-neighborhood verification passed 477,315 exact labelled configurations across 39 graph-size pairs, with additional 49-size-pair formula checks. The finite-quotient proof, not extrapolation, covers all positive sizes.

value.rationale: The first entrance to eventual periodicity is a natural finite-time dynamical invariant. Beyond the already known m=2 book-graph case, the all-m>=3 exact nine-cell census reveals a new four-way limiting clock: for m=3 and n tending to infinity, the distinct oscillatory entry classes 0,1,2,3 each have limiting conditional probability 1/4, whereas for every m>=4 the immediate recurrence class dominates each delayed class. This sharp structural difference accompanies exact extinction basins, primitive orbit counts and transient cutoff for every graph size; the exact finite-size and limiting facts are not merely a textbook deduction from the qualitative criterion.
